prompt:
Subject:
Watermelon Splitting Under the Summer Sky

Main Subject:
On a midsummer beach, a woman in her 20s is on her knees on the sand, leaning her upper body far forward, pressing a wooden stick with both hands against a split watermelon. The composition has depth, with a large split watermelon and splashing water in the foreground, hands gripping the stick in the center, and the smiling face of the woman in the background. The focus is on the bright blue sky, blue sea, long wind-blown silver-white hair, green sunglasses, and purple floral chiffon dress.

Person/Expression:
A young woman with bright ivory skin. Soft oval face with a small rounded chin. Natural gloss from the midsummer sun on cheeks, nose, shoulders, collarbone, and arms, with fine water droplets for a realistic texture. Thin ash-brown eyebrows in a gentle arch. Light beige and moss green eyeshadow, thin eyeliner, and naturally separated lashes. Light rose-pink blush and translucent coral-pink lip gloss. Laughing joyfully with mouth open, showing white teeth naturally. Looking toward the camera. Wearing large, rounded, translucent green sunglasses with thin silver metal frames. Bright platinum blonde hair reaching near the waist. Thin, uneven bangs and long layers around the face, with most of the hair flowing toward the left in the sea breeze.

Clothing/Pose:
A lightweight chiffon camisole mini dress with a lavender, pale purple, white, and green floral print. Featuring thin straps, a soft V-neckline, and a small knot with trailing ribbons at the center chest. The skirt flares slightly from the waist with multiple tiers of thin ruffles and wavy edges. The hem on the right side of the screen sways in the sea breeze, showing overlapping layers of translucent chiffon and floral patterns. Layered silver bead necklaces and a transparent teardrop pendant. Silver earrings and a thin bracelet. Pale lavender nails. The woman is on her knees, leaning her upper body deep forward, gripping a wooden stick strongly with both hands at the bottom center. Arms are nearly straight, fingers wrapping naturally around the stick. The stick extends diagonally from the hands toward the watermelon in the foreground left.

Background/Light:
A large watermelon with light and dark green stripes in the foreground left, split vertically with bright red flesh visible. Strong white reflections on the wet surface, with water droplets of various sizes splashing upward from the split and stick. A blue and white striped picnic mat in the foreground right. Bright beige sand behind, with the blue-green sea and horizon visible in the middle ground. Distant people and parasols are softly blurred. The majority of the background is a vivid blue sky with few clouds. White seagulls flying above are slightly blurred. Strong midday sunlight from the top left creates bright highlights. Natural shadows on the neck, chest, and dress folds. Subtle blue reflections from the sky and sea in the shadows for a refreshing summer tone.

Composition/Camera:
Vertical 2:3. Low camera position near the sand, looking slightly up at the person. Subject positioned large from center to right, captured from head to knees. The face is near the top center, hands below the center, and the watermelon occupies the foreground left. Wide-angle perspective making the foreground watermelon and stick appear larger. Face, hands, stick, and watermelon split are on a diagonal line. High shutter speed used to freeze water droplets and wind-blown hair.

Texture/Style:
Photorealistic photograph. Bright and refreshing summer fashion portrait. Precise depiction of skin moisture, wet watermelon skin, clear water droplets, light chiffon fabric, fine hair, and metal accessory reflections. Vivid blue sky and sea, with accents of purple, green, and red. Sharp subject and foreground, with natural optical bokeh in the background.

Negative:
Short hair, dark hair, opaque black sunglasses, swimwear, plain clothing, intact watermelon, single-handed grip, stick not touching hands, extra limbs/fingers, unnatural face, illustration style, text, logos.
